comment.narrative: It can be confirmed from the interim report covering the period 01022023 31012024.

The meetings were held with the participation of a total of 155 representatives. The diversity in the city profiles of the representatives who attended the meetings from all over Turkey especially the 7 cities of the project was found remarkable. Within the scope of the project representatives of civil society organizations working in intersectional fields within the framework of a holistic approach to human rights especially youth human rights religionbelief groups women and LGBTI areas also attended the meetings. Examples of these include the right to the city minority rights refugee rights animal rights climate and environmental rights. The meetings were seen as a preliminary step to expand networks in the civil sphere and make progress in work areas. In this context content information about the modules their development processes general outlines and scopes were shared with the participants at the meetings on the basis of learning outcomes.
